title: authoring-ui tsc errors: test fixtures missing motionEaseType/motionSnap/shapeEaseType, wrong symbol type string
description:
packages/authoring-ui has 19 TypeScript errors in test and production files:

1. movieExplorer.test.ts lines 167, 243, 379: Frame object literals missing motionEaseType, motionSnap, shapeEaseType required fields (same pattern as task 1165 fixed for @flash/swf). Fix: add motionEaseType: 'none', motionSnap: false, shapeEaseType: 'none' to all inline Frame literals.

2. PropertiesPanel.tsx line 2287: comparison uses 'drawing' but the type union is 'drawing-object'. Fix: change 'drawing' to 'drawing-object'.

3. Timeline.tsx line 936: unused variable 'layerId'. Fix: remove or prefix with _.

4. registry.ts line 1578: Type 'false' not assignable to type 'true' — production type error. Read the context to determine the correct fix.

5. registry.test.ts: several type assertions using 'movie-clip' (should be 'movieclip'?) and LibraryItem type assertion issues. Read and fix.

6. propertiesPanelGroup.test.ts line 44: Expected 6 arguments but got 5. Read to fix.

7. useKeyboardShortcuts.test.ts line 109: Missing onDuplicate, onRemoveFrame, onClearKeyframe handlers in test. Read to fix.

Run: cd packages/authoring-ui && npx tsc --noEmit to verify all 19 errors are resolved.
